candidates.name: Quiet Dock
candidates.hypothesis: A familiar session sidebar and a small two-row shared composer remove visual burden without relocating the work.

search.presentation: 32px quiet labelled row; full search field on activation

navigation.newSession: 32px neutral row with 16px plus, not a full-width dark CTA

layout.navigation: Persistent 216px sidebar, 8px insets, 32px session rows. Workspace selector first; new session and search remain separate quiet actions.

composer.placementConversation: Docked at bottom of conversation pane
rowLayout: Input occupies full width on row 1.
Row 2: Attach 32, Slash 32, Agent fit-content max128, Model fit-content max176; 4px action gaps; Send/Stop 32 at far right.
Input baseline and controls share one shell. Context values use 12/18; labels never stretch.
composer.heightFormula: 8 + (attachments ? 32 + 8 : 0) + clamp(24, textarea scrollHeight, 144) + 32 + 8; 22px hint zone is outside.

layout.context: Agent and model in the composer toolbar; workspace is in navigation; warnings remain above composer.

interactions: At pane widths below 600, show one 32px Settings control labelled with Agent/Model summary; its popover exposes both selectors. Slash and Send remain direct.
At viewport below 1200, opening inspector hides persistent navigation and provides a return control.
At 200% zoom, effective CSS width controls reflow; no CSS scale transform.

candidates.name: Threadline
candidates.hypothesis: Put configuration beside the session and the next input directly after the response, reducing the distance between reading and writing.

userMessage.surface: No bubble; 2px logical-start marker and 12px inset, user label above

search.presentation: Search icon beside 32px New session in sidebar action row

navigation.newSession: Small neutral text button sharing row with search

layout.navigation: Persistent 200px sidebar. Compact workspace row and one New/Search action row precede sessions.

composer.placementEmpty: In document flow below the small New work title
composer.placementConversation: In transcript flow 20px after latest assistant block; never moves to screen center
rowLayout: One row: Attach 32, input flexible min120, Slash 32, Send/Stop 32; 8px gaps.
Attach/send align to the bottom of multiline input; their targets do not stretch.
Agent and Model are fit-content 28px controls in the 32px session context bar, beneath the main header, not in the field.
composer.heightFormula: 10 + (attachments ? 32 + 8 : 0) + max(32, clamp(24, textarea scrollHeight, 144)) + 10; 22px hint outside.

layout.context: Top context bar: Agent, Model, requested/observed context status; never a fabricated token budget.

interactions: When the input is below the visible transcript, a 32px Write control in the context bar scrolls and focuses it; it does not overlay a second composer.
New streamed content keeps focused composer visible only while the user is already at the latest content; do not drag the reader away from older messages.
With inspector open or pane narrower than 760px, reduce gutters to24; below600 collapse context values into a labelled Settings popover.
Inline permission card appears before composer and in document order; keyboard can always reach it.

candidates.name: Rail Workbench
candidates.hypothesis: Give artifacts and the transcript most of the window by moving session navigation into a drawer and making composition an integrated bottom shelf.

userMessage.surface: No bubble; user label above a compact unboxed request

search.presentation: Rail Search target opens the session drawer with search focused

navigation.sessionAccess: Labelled Sessions rail button plus session title button; tooltip alone is not the only access label

composer.surface: Canvas; one functional top divider, no outer rounded box

layout.navigation: 56px rail with 32px targets: Sessions, Search, New session, Files, Extensions; bottom workspace/location. A 256px modal drawer exposes the same workspace and full session list.

composer.placementEmpty: Integrated bottom shelf of conversation pane
composer.placementConversation: Same bottom shelf; never spans the inspector
composer.width: pane width; input content aligns with thread start and max width
rowLayout: Row 1 min32 inside 4px top/bottom padding: Attach 32, input flexible, Send/Stop32; 8px gaps.
Row 2 28px: Slash28, Agent fit-content max128, Model fit-content max176; current workspace scope text at end.
Connection/errors live above the shelf; keyboard hint is available as associated help and only shown on focus, without adding fixed empty height.
composer.heightFormula: 4 + (attachments ? 32 + 8 : 0) + max(32, clamp(24, textarea scrollHeight, 144)) + 4 + 28; divider is inset and does not add a CSS pixel.

layout.context: Workspace and session title in header; agent/model/scope in lower shelf row.

interactions: Click Sessions opens modal drawer; selection closes drawer and restores focus to the active session title.

Rail is not five unlabeled mystery icons: tooltip on focus and visible accessible labels in the drawer; persistent Sessions button may include a small textual indicator only if it still fits32 target.
Below600 CSS px replace rail with header Navigation button; full single-pane width takes priority.
At narrow composer width, lower row becomes one Context control plus Slash; scope warning remains separately visible.

disabled.behavior: No action; preserve accessible name and adjacent reason when consequential.

selected.behavior: Expose aria-current or aria-selected for its actual pattern, not both indiscriminately.

read-only.behavior: Keep text selectable; label Read only. Do not imply editable affordance.

error.behavior: Set aria-invalid; associate a concrete message; preserve entered text.

default.behavior: Show only observed content and its source.

loading.behavior: Stable content footprint, static Loading label, aria-busy; never a synthetic progress percentage.

empty.behavior: State that the successful read returned no items, separately from unavailable.

error.behavior: Readable cause and safe next action; keep last content only with Stale label.

unknown.behavior: Result unknown, not failure or success; no automatic resend or replay; offer reconciliation if available.

stale.behavior: Show last observed timestamp and Stale label; disable effect/permission actions until fresh.

unavailable.behavior: Explain absent capability or connection without claiming an empty result.

foundations.northStar: A quiet local desktop workbench: compact control chrome, readable working content, and explicit authority at consequential actions.

typography.loading: No network font loading for preview. Actual web font is the locally resolved system face; do not claim Noto renders on macOS.
typography.localization: Korean prose uses normal word wrapping; overflow-wrap:anywhere for paths/IDs. Never truncate permission scope.
typography.distinction: Field content uses input/body role. Button, agent/model and navigation chrome use ui/label/smallLabel; reducing chrome does not mechanically reduce message text.
typography.rolesFormat: Each common role array is [size px, line-height px, weight]. Resolve semantic.type.<role> tokens for actual candidate/mode values.

spacing.rule: Main layout uses 4px multiples. Intentional 2px subdivisions never create targets smaller than24. Border1px is a stroke, not a spacing unit.

icons.library: Existing lucide-react geometry or matching local inline SVG in preview; no dependency addition.
icons.rule: Every target is a real nonoverlapping box; 16px glyph does not mean16px click area.

borders.decorative: Only pane division, code region and grouped section where needed; decorative edges are not required to reach3:1.
borders.interactive: Standalone field/composer boundary uses semantic.color.border.interactive and is checked at3:1 to its field background.
borders.focus: 2px focus outline +2px offset; menu uses inset focus to avoid clipping.
borders.selection: Fill plus text weight or selected marker; no row separator for every session.
borders.composerMeasurement: Paint the composer stroke as an inset non-layout pseudo-element. Height formulas describe the entire shell; do not add2px of CSS border after calculating them. Focus outline remains separate.

elevation.base: No shadow for shell, sidebar, composer, messages, code or permission cards.
elevation.menu: Only anchored menus/tooltips/toasts may use the menu shadow.
elevation.modal: Only dialog/drawer uses modal shadow and scrim.

motion.purpose: Communicate hover, overlay origin and panel state; do not animate token text or smooth-scroll every streamed chunk.
motion.reducedMotion: Durations0; disable transform, shimmer and pulsing; use a static Running label.
motion.scroll: Use instant scroll for focus restoration and reduced motion; user reading position wins.

accessibility.focus: Visible for every keyboard action, never clipped or obscured by dock; scroll-margin8 on focusable rows.
accessibility.zoom200: Use CSS viewport reflow. At an effective width of640, navigation and inspector are mutually exclusive overlays; messages and controls wrap. No transform scale.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use Canvas/CanvasText/Field/FieldText/ButtonText/Highlight/HighlightText; preserve2px outlines and1px control borders with currentColor; remove shadows; let forced-color-adjust:auto apply. Selected states use text/marker as well as fill.
accessibility.screenReader: Landmarks nav/main/complementary; labelled transcript, composer and status; stable focus; no per-token live announcement.
accessibility.coarsePointer: Increase real control rows/targets to44 and gaps to8; composer and menu height recalculate from content, not fixed72/52/68 values.

wide.behavior: Persistent nav plus inspector allowed only while main pane remains at least480. Clamp resize using actual available width.

medium.behavior: Nav may persist when inspector closed. Opening inspector hides nav; main remains at least480 or inspector becomes modal.

narrow.behavior: Nav and inspector are modal overlays, one at a time; main gutters24; context selectors may collapse.

small.behavior: Main gutters16; hide rail; full-width dialog/sheet minus16px edges; wrap permission actions; keep Send and Slash reachable. At320px no page horizontal scroll; code has local horizontal scroll.

shortHeight.behavior: Scrollable one-pane layout; textarea cap80; no vertically centered empty hero; permission card in document flow, not a clipped queue. Focused control scrolls into view.
